```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
					  fig.align = "center", fig.width = 7.5)
library(ggplot2)
diag <- params$diag

steps <- diag$steps
# a chunk run twice appends its steps twice: keep the last run of each step
steps <- steps[!duplicated(paste(steps$dataset, steps$step), fromLast = TRUE), ]
steps$removed <- steps$n_in - steps$n_out
steps$pct_removed <- ifelse(steps$n_in > 0, 100 * steps$removed / steps$n_in, NA)
steps$reason <- if ("why" %in% names(steps)) steps$why else seafisheries:::step_reason(steps$step)
datasets <- unique(steps$dataset)
# section titles for the dataset keys used by the workflows
ds_labels <- c(captain = "Captain logbooks", observer = "Observer logbooks",
			   raised = "Raised catch and effort", LF_opr = "Operational length frequency",
			   LF_port = "Port sampling lengths", LF_obs = "Observer lengths",
			   LF_agg = "Aggregated length frequency", hampel = "Hampel filter")
ds_label <- function(ds) ifelse(ds %in% names(ds_labels), ds_labels[ds], ds)
# selection steps (other species, gears, data sources) are not data loss
steps$selection <- grepl("sp_code|SP_ID", steps$step)

# titles and notes for the tables outside the dataset sections
table_info <- list(
	merge_cap_obs = c("Merging captain and observer records",
		"Captain records matching an observer record (flag, vessel, day, 1 deg cell) are removed: the observer record is kept."),
	catch_unknown_opr = c("Species recorded with neither number nor weight",
		"Operational records; the catch of these species is unknown and set to 0."),
	na_weight_opr = c("Missing weights after merging",
		"Partial weights set to NA, extrapolated after the monthly aggregation."),
	raised_shared_strata = c("Raised records sharing a stratum",
		"Records with the same flag, fleet, month and 5 deg cell (merged by the old SQL query)."),
	LF_agg_fish = c("Aggregated LF: rows and fish",
		"process_lf_data() merges rows of a sample with the same length, so rows drop more than fish."),
	LF_opr_agg = c("Operational length samples", "Fish measured, aggregated to one record per sample id and day."),
	weight_direct_check = c("Observer length weights", "Each observer sample must be split across its catch records with weights summing to 1."),
	match_types = c("How operational records got a length", "NA: no operational length; filled from aggregated LF if possible."),
	monthly_aggregation = c("Monthly aggregation", "Records per vessel x month x 1 deg cell; removed: no catch of any species."),
	settings = c("Settings", ""),
	input_check = c("Clustering variables vs the clustering data",
		"Complete records of the fit years scaled with the saved clustering parameters: expected mean 0 and sd 1. A departure means a variable is not built as in the data the clustering was fitted on."),
	label_map = c("Cluster numbers", "Saved cluster number, after merging, and fishery number."),
	assignment_accuracy = c("Assignment accuracy",
		"Reference records (complete, fit years) assigned by discriminant analysis, compared with their k-means fishery. Share of effort."),
	assignment_by_fishery = c("Assignment without HBF, per fishery", "Recall: share of the fishery's effort assigned to it; precision: share of the effort assigned to it that belongs to it."),
	assignment_confusion = c("Assignment without HBF: confusion", "k-means fishery in rows, assigned in columns, share of effort."),
	assignment_by_flag = c("Assignment without HBF, per flag", ""),
	opr_fisheries = c("Operational fisheries", "low_prob: records assigned with a probability below 0.8."),
	strata_accuracy = c("Raised-like records: accuracy", "Reference records aggregated to flag x month x 5 deg strata and assigned."),
	strata_by_purity = c("Raised-like records: accuracy by purity", "Purity: effort share of the stratum's main fishery."),
	strata_by_fishery = c("Raised-like records: per fishery", ""),
	opr_prior_tiers = c("Prior used for the operational records without HBF", ""),
	rai_prior_tiers = c("Prior used for the raised records", ""),
	rai_fisheries = c("Raised records by fishery", "NA: records without catch in numbers."),
	delta_summary = c("Delta records", "unassigned: delta in cells where no raised record could be assigned, left out of the outputs."),
	delta_by_flag = c("Delta per flag", "Catch of the species (mt): clipped = cells where operational > raised."),
	delta_by_year = c("Delta per year", ""),
	lf_routing_structural = c("Length routing: structural checks", "Must all be 0."),
	lf_routing_conservation = c("Length routing: conservation", "Fish measured vs routed to an operational fishery."),
	lf_routing_unmatched = c("Length samples never matched", ""),
	lf_raised_routing = c("Aggregated lengths routed to a fishery", ""),
	fisheries = c("Fisheries", "After the Hampel filter."),
	weight_extrapolation = c("Weight extrapolation", "Monthly records with a missing weight, filled with n x mean weight per fish (same month and 5 deg cell)."),
	LF_regions = c("Aggregated LF regions", "Regions entirely on land are excluded from the length weighting."),
	lf_coverage = c("Source of the mean length", "Monthly operational records by matching tier."),
	lf_usage = c("Aggregated LF used", "Aggregated LF entries matched to at least one operational record.")
)

fmt_n <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)

# latex table as text, to cat() in results = "asis" chunks; long text columns
# wrapped with p{} widths
tab <- function(df, caption = NULL, widths = NULL, digits = 2) {
	if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || nrow(df) == 0 || ncol(df) == 0) {
		return("\n\n\\emph{Nothing to report.}\n\n")
	}
	# identifiers and years: no thousands separator
	for (v in intersect(names(df), c("yr", "year", "decade", "f", "cluster", "kmeans")))
		df[[v]] <- as.character(df[[v]])
	align <- if (is.null(widths)) NULL else ifelse(is.na(widths), "l", paste0("p{", widths, "}"))
	knitr::kable(df, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE, row.names = FALSE,
				 caption = caption, digits = digits, align = align,
				 format.args = list(big.mark = ","), escape = TRUE) |>
		paste(collapse = "\n") |>
		(\(x) paste0("\n\n", x, "\n\n"))()
}

tables <- diag$tables
used_tables <- character(0)
tables_for <- function(ds, prefix) {
	key <- gsub(" ", "_", ds)
	nm <- names(tables)[startsWith(names(tables), paste0(prefix, "_", key))]
	used_tables <<- c(used_tables, nm)
	nm
}
```

Source: `r gsub("_", "\\\\_", params$source_file)`
Species: **`r diag$species`**, SQL download: `r diag$request_tag`, processed: `r format(diag$rendered, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")`.

# Overview

Records entering and leaving the cleaning steps of each dataset. Selected:
records of the species, gear and data sources processed (not counted as
losses, nor shown in the plot). Steps that
only transform values (coordinate conversion, HBF flags, length codes) remove
nothing. Records removed by later steps of the workflow (merging, aggregation)
are covered in "Other checks".

```{r overview, results = "asis"}
ov <- do.call(rbind, lapply(datasets, function(ds) {
	s <- steps[steps$dataset == ds, ]
	sel <- s[s$selection, ]
	n_sel <- if (nrow(sel)) sel$n_out[nrow(sel)] else s$n_in[1]
	data.frame(Dataset = ds, Downloaded = s$n_in[1], Selected = n_sel, Cleaned = s$n_out[nrow(s)],
			   `Retained (% of selected)` = round(100 * s$n_out[nrow(s)] / n_sel, 2), check.names = FALSE)
}))
cat(tab(ov))
```

```{r removed_plot, fig.height = 0.25 * max(8, sum(steps$removed > 0 & !steps$selection)) + 1.5}
p <- steps[steps$removed > 0 & !steps$selection, ]
if (nrow(p)) {
	p$label <- paste0(p$step, "  (", fmt_n(p$removed), ")")
	p$label <- factor(p$label, levels = rev(unique(p$label)))
	p$dataset <- factor(p$dataset, levels = datasets)
	ggplot(p, aes(x = pct_removed, y = label)) +
		geom_col(fill = "grey40", width = 0.7) +
		facet_grid(dataset ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
		labs(x = "Records removed (% of records entering the step)", y = NULL,
			 title = "Records removed per step") +
		theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
		theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0), strip.background = element_blank())
}
```

# Warnings

```{r warnings, results = "asis"}
w <- diag$warnings
if (is.null(w) || length(w) == 0) {
	cat("No warnings recorded.\n")
} else {
	for (n in names(w)) cat("- **", gsub("_", "\\\\_", n), "**: ",
							gsub("_", "\\\\_", paste(unique(w[[n]]), collapse = "; ")), "\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r datasets, results = "asis"}
for (ds in datasets) {
	cat("\n\n# ", ds_label(ds), "\n\n", sep = "")

	s <- steps[steps$dataset == ds, ]
	cat("## Cleaning steps\n\n")
	cat(tab(data.frame(Step = s$step, In = fmt_n(s$n_in), Out = fmt_n(s$n_out),
						 Removed = fmt_n(s$removed), `%` = round(s$pct_removed, 2),
						 Reason = s$reason, check.names = FALSE),
			  widths = c("4cm", NA, NA, NA, NA, "6.5cm")))

	for (nm in tables_for(ds, "stage")) {
		cat("\n\n## Input vs processed\n\n")
		cat("Input: values in the raw data (% of raw records with a value). ",
			"Processed: % of raw records (or ids) still present, with a value, after cleaning.\n\n")
		cat(tab(tables[[nm]], widths = c("2.8cm", "3.2cm", "2.4cm", "3.2cm", "2.6cm")))
	}
	for (nm in tables_for(ds, "catch_quality")) {
		cat("\n\n## Catch quality (raw)\n\n")
		cat("Records where the species is recorded, and where its number or weight is missing on all (or some) of its catch lines. ",
			"Missing numbers count as 0 fish; missing weights are extrapolated from the mean weight per fish.\n\n")
		cat(tab(tables[[nm]][, setdiff(names(tables[[nm]]), "dataset")]))
	}
	for (nm in tables_for(ds, "coords")) {
		sfx <- sub(paste0("coords_", gsub(" ", "_", ds), "_?"), "", nm)
		cat("\n\n## Coordinates that could not be converted", if (nzchar(sfx)) paste0(" (", sfx, ")"), "\n\n", sep = "")
		cat("Counts are distinct raw values, not records. These positions become NA.\n\n")
		cat(tab(tables[[nm]], widths = c(NA, NA, NA, "7cm")))
	}
}
```

```{r other, results = "asis"}
other <- setdiff(names(tables), used_tables)
if (length(other)) {
	cat("\n\n# Other checks\n\n")
	for (nm in other) {
		info <- table_info[[nm]]
		cat("\n\n## ", if (is.null(info)) gsub("_", " ", nm) else info[1], "\n\n", sep = "")
		if (!is.null(info)) cat(info[2], "\n\n")
		w <- if (startsWith(nm, "stage_")) c("2.8cm", "3.2cm", "2.4cm", "3.2cm", "2.6cm") else
			 if (startsWith(nm, "coords_")) c(NA, NA, NA, "7cm") else NULL
		cat(tab(tables[[nm]], widths = w))
	}
}
```

```{r lf_plot, fig.height = 2.5}
cov <- tables$lf_coverage
if (!is.null(cov) && all(c("Tier", "Pct") %in% names(cov))) {
	cov$Tier <- factor(cov$Tier, levels = rev(cov$Tier))
	ggplot(cov, aes(x = Pct, y = Tier)) +
		geom_col(fill = "grey40", width = 0.6) +
		geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Pct, "%")), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
		scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
		labs(x = "Monthly operational records (%)", y = NULL, title = "Source of the mean length") +
		theme_bw(base_size = 9)
}
```

# Appendix: console output of each step

```{r messages, results = "asis"}
for (n in names(diag$messages)) {
	cat("\n\n**", gsub("_", "\\\\_", n), "**\n\n", sep = "")
	txt <- unlist(lapply(diag$messages[[n]], function(l) if (nchar(l) > 100) strwrap(l, 100, exdent = 4) else l))
	cat("```\n", paste(txt, collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n", sep = "")
}
```
